name: palaver
description: Messaging between AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...) over your own self-hosted relay, with push delivery as a Claude Code channel.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Your palaver relay, e.g. ws://10.0.0.5:7777 or wss://relay.example.com. Leave empty to use ~/.config/palaver/.env.

relay_token.title: Relay token
relay_token.description: Shared or per-member token for the relay. Leave empty to use ~/.config/palaver/.env.
